AccountChange.description: One account of the transfer, before and after it; balances in EUR as decimal strings

AssessmentAnswer.description: The answer to one question: a choice key, an amount or number as a decimal string, or a short text

CalculateRequest.description: Calculate a proposal, with the values the persona changed

parameters.description: Only the changed values; empty or missing to calculate as proposed

ChangedValue.description: A value the persona changed, in the parameter's unit (a rate as a fraction: 0.04 = 4 %)

ChatAssessment.description: The assessment card: every open profile question in one form

status.description: OPEN: waiting for Save my answers; SAVED: answered below; CANCELLED: a later question replaced it

ChatAssessmentField.description: One question of the assessment card

input.description: CHOICE: choice chips; EUR: amount in euros; NUMBER: whole number; SLIDER: options from the lower to the upper end; TEXT: short text

key.description: The key to answer it by

max.description: Largest NUMBER or EUR value, or the longest TEXT

options.description: The choices of CHOICE and SLIDER; empty otherwise

provId.description: The figure a pre-filled value is; only on pre-filled questions

unit.description: The unit after a NUMBER field, e.g. years

value.description: The value from your account data, as a decimal string; only on pre-filled questions

ChatAssessmentOption.description: One choice of an assessment question

description.description: What the check makes sure of, in plain words

id.description: Shown only as a small caption

ChatHandover.description: What the card shows of a case for a human advisor

reason.description: A plain reason class, e.g. "because I couldn't confirm every figure in my answer"; null when there is none

status.description: OPEN: waiting for the advisor; CLOSED: answered

assessment.description: The form with every profile question still open; only on ASK_PROFILE answers

checks.description: The checks Fine's answer passed or failed, shown under "Checks"; empty on other messages and on fixed answers

figures.description: The figures a calculated answer used, shown as figure chips; empty on other messages

handover.description: The case for a human advisor; only on answers passed to an advisor (ESCALATE)

needsStatement.description: The demands-and-needs statement; only on RECOMMEND_CATEGORY answers to an insurance question

outcome.description: How the turn ended; only on Fine's answers

premise.description: The false assumption a question makes, in one sentence; only on DETECT_TRAP answers

proposal.description: "Here's what I understood": the values a calculation will run with; only on COMPUTE answers that ask before calculating

range.description: The range chart of a calculated what-if; only on COMPUTE answers to a what-if

recommendation.description: "Why this fits you": the Suitability Statement; only on RECOMMEND_CATEGORY answers

replyTo.description: The question an answer replies to; only on Fine's answers

suggestions.description: Suggestion chips of Fine's answer: question texts that send themselves; empty on other messages

ChatProposal.description: The values a calculation will run with, shown before calculating

range.description: Whether Calculate answers with a range chart (a what-if) instead of a written answer

status.description: OPEN: waiting for Calculate; CALCULATED: answered below; CANCELLED: a later question replaced it

ChatProposalParameter.description: One value of a proposed calculation

key.description: The key to change it by

provId.description: The figure an account-data value is; only for ACCOUNT_DATA

source.description: QUESTION: from your question; ACCOUNT_DATA: from your account data; CHANGED: changed by you

ChatRangeChart.description: Where a what-if may lead, from Fine's calculation engine: a range, not a promise

assumptions.description: Return model, costs, inflation, horizon and subsidy rule

points.description: The percentiles at the end of each year

provId.description: Key of the projection's provenance (its middle outcome), for "Why?"

ChatRangePoint.description: A what-if's percentiles at the end of one year (EUR)

ChatRecommendation.description: The Suitability Statement of a Category Recommendation, from Fine's calculation engine and your profile

conflicts.description: Where the plan conflicts with your profile; empty if it fits

costs.description: The ex-ante costs; empty for a recommendation without investment

facts.description: The profile facts the selection used

ChatRecommendationFact.description: One profile fact a recommendation used

reason.description: Why the transfer was not made; absent once done

why.description: The "Why?" explanation of the reason; absent once done

DatedFigure.description: A balance on a day, e.g. the first forecast day below zero

wholeEuros.description: The amount rounded to whole euros (half up), for the chart marker and running text

EmergencyFund.description: The emergency fund (overnight deposit) against its target

months.description: Months of expenses in the target

Figure.description: A figure from Fine's calculation engine with the key of its provenance

Forecast.description: The daily current account forecast over three months (EUR)

ForecastPoint.description: One forecast day: the expected balance and its possible range

Holding.description: A holding in the securities account

lowestBalance.description: The lowest expected balance in the next three months

shortfall.description: The first day the expected balance is below zero; absent if it never is

InsuranceContract.description: An insurance or pension contract on which you are insured

coInsured.description: Whether you are co-insured on someone else's policy

nextDueDate.description: The next due date after today; absent without a premium

premium.description: The premium per payment interval; absent if you don't pay it

InsuranceFlag.description: A plain-words note on your insurance: cover you may pay twice for, or essential cover you don't have

contractIds.description: Ids of every contract involved (empty for a missing cover)

Limits.description: A rule's limits; EUR as decimal strings

floor.description: The source account's minimum balance after a transfer

overnightDeposit.description: Absent if there is no overnight deposit

shortfall.description: The first day the expected balance is below zero; absent if it never is

Money.description: An amount of money: decimal string with two fraction digits plus currency.

NeedsArea.description: One area of the demands-and-needs statement

check.description: What to check, and with whom

need.description: Why the cover matters for you

NeedsStatement.description: The demands-and-needs statement for your insurance, from Fine's calculation engine, your answers and the contracts in your banking data; it recommends no product

areas.description: Liability, occupational disability and cover held twice, in this order

facts.description: The facts about you the statement used

figures.description: Contracts per cover and risks covered more than once

Notification.description: A note from Fine's monitoring, with the figures that triggered it

actionId.description: The Action Fine prepared, for "Review and confirm"; absent if none

question.description: The prepared chat question for "Ask Fine about this"; absent if none

reason.description: Why the Action needs your OK, in plain words; absent if none

today.description: The persona's simulated date; present only under the research profile

ProblemCode.description: Closed set of machine-readable error codes.

ProblemDetail.description: RFC 9457 problem details with a closed code.

Projection.description: Where the investments may lead: a range, not a promise

provId.description: Key of the projection's provenance (its middle outcome)

ProjectionPoint.description: The projection's percentiles at the end of one year (EUR)

provId.description: The input's own figure key, where it is itself a figure

value.description: Decimal string; absent for a text input

validFrom.description: First day this version applies; absent if unknown

validTo.description: Last day this version applies; absent if open-ended

fromName.description: The account money comes from; absent if it no longer exists

toName.description: The account money goes to; absent if it no longer exists
